departments.description: AI and Machine Learning engineering department

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence Foundations
courses.description: Core principles of machine learning models, search algorithms, logic programming, and AI ethics.

courses.title: Financial Accounting Principles
courses.description: Introduction to ledger balances, trial logs, financial statements, and balance sheet orchestration.

courses.title: SAP FICO Ledger & Cost Control
courses.description: Configuring profit-centers, asset ledgers, internal codes, and ledger cost calculations in SAP NetWeaver.

courses.title: SAP ABAP Programming Basics
courses.description: Learn syntax parameters, logic control flows, internal dictionary variables, and tables in SAP environments.

courses.title: Advanced ABAP & Database Orchestration
courses.description: Orchestrating custom SAP database views, remote function calls, BAPIs, and Web Dynpro custom dashboards.

courses.title: Corporate HR & Recruitment Strategies
courses.description: Sourcing strategies, payroll structures, hiring funnels, onboarding checklists, and labor law regulations.

courses.title: Employee Relations and Labor Laws
courses.description: Workplace arbitration, state compliance guides, payroll taxes, benefit rules, and employee feedback loops.

courses.title: Computer Vision & Multi-Modal Generative Models
courses.description: Convolutional networks, Vision Transformers (ViT), Latent Diffusion Models, U-Net denoising, and CLIP embedding spaces.

courses.title: Reinforcement Learning & Autonomous Decision Agents
courses.description: Markov Decision Processes, Q-learning, Policy Gradients, PPO, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and Multi-Agent Orchestration.

courses.title: Production MLOps, Model Governance & AI Ethics
courses.description: Model containerization, Kubernetes serving, TensorRT optimization, feature stores, drift detection, and algorithmic fairness.

courses.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
courses.description: A practical deep-dive guide to constructing CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers using PyTorch framework.
